name: Phoenix Labs
moreInfo: Founded in 2014 by former Riot Games employees. Phoenix Labs effectively ceased operations in 2025 following massive layoffs and the shutdown of their flagship title, Dauntless, on May 29, 2025. Read more on [Game Developer](https://www.gamedeveloper.com/).

name: Singularity 6
moreInfo: Singularity 6 was founded by former Riot Games developers with a vision to create deeply social online games. Their debut title, Palia, is a cozy MMO that emphasizes community and collaboration over competition.

name: Theorycraft Games
moreInfo: Theorycraft Games is a studio founded by ex-Riot, Blizzard, and Bungie veterans. Their first project, Supervive, was shut down in February 2026 as it failed to maintain a large enough player base. The studio remains active and plans to focus on smaller, sharply focused games. Read more on [PC Gamer](https://www.pcgamer.com/).

name: Lightforge Games
moreInfo: Lightforge Games laid off the majority of its staff and paused development on Project ORCS in May 2024 due to funding issues. The company is effectively out of business. Read more on [Game Developer](https://www.gamedeveloper.com/).

name: Gardens
moreInfo: Gardens is an indie studio founded by former Riot and Journey developers. Their mission is to create beautiful, cooperative multiplayer experiences. Their first game is still unannounced.

name: The Believer Company
moreInfo: The Believer Company is focused on building games that foster camaraderie and generosity among players. Founded by ex-Riot and Sirvo Studios talent, they are working on an unannounced cooperative game.

name: Vela Games
moreInfo: Vela Games remains active, but shut down the servers for Evercore Heroes in October 2025 due to low player counts and funding challenges. Read more on [PCGamesN](https://www.pcgamesn.com/).

name: Elodie Games
moreInfo: Elodie Games shut down on March 31, 2025, just 18 days after launching Seekers of Skyveil in Early Access, citing financial challenges. Read more on [MMOs.com](https://mmos.com/).

name: Treehouse Games
moreInfo: Treehouse Games, founded by Michael Chu (former Riot Games employee) and Ryan Sullivan (co-founder of Sirvo Studios), raised $2.6M in seed funding to develop cooperative games. The studio aims to create games that 'evoke the camaraderie of a road trip, allow generosity among friends, and celebrate lasting accomplishments.' Their funding round was led by London Venture Partners. The team combines talent from both AAA companies and startups, focusing on creating social gaming experiences that go beyond traditional competitive gameplay.

name: Venn
moreInfo: Venn was a gaming-focused streaming network that launched in 2020 and furloughed staff in 2021 before going defunct due to viewership and financial issues. Read more on [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VENN).

name: Pragma
moreInfo: Pragma provides backend technology for live service games. Founded by ex-Riot and PopCap engineers, Pragma has raised over $50M to support game studios with scalable infrastructure.

name: Wonderstorm
moreInfo: Wonderstorm is the studio behind the hit animated series The Dragon Prince and its upcoming game Xadia. Founded by former Riot and Naughty Dog talent, Wonderstorm blends storytelling and interactive experiences.

name: Ganymede Games
moreInfo: Founded by Jerry Prochazka (ex-Riot Director of People) and Rob Thompson (ex-Riot/Wargaming), Ganymede Games is an independent studio based in Las Cruces, NM. Focused on creating immersive worlds that respect players' time, their first title is 'Dark Sky,' a card-based RPG adventure available on Steam.

name: Sprocket Games
moreInfo: Sprocket Games was founded by former Riot Games developers with a focus on cross-platform social adventure games and a developer-focused workplace.

name: Pahdo Labs
moreInfo: Pahdo Labs is developing anime-style action games and creation platforms, including Starlight Re:Volver. Founded by Daniel Zou and team members from Capcom, Riot, and Ubisoft.
